text:
Alex W.: Heads-up — canary rollout v0.57 hit a perf regression on kv-heavy traces, pausing rollout. Repro in staging with seq_len=1024 workloads. :frowning:
Priya S.: seen it, thanks. Is this the kernel-selector change from last week?
Miguel R.: likely. I ran a quick profile; the hot path shows a sudden increase in L2 misses when kernel_prefer_int8=true on aarch64.
Jenna L.: repo + commit?
Miguel R.: commit 9a1b2c3 (runtime/kernel-selector): changed heuristic to prefer quantized kernels for short-prefixed batches.
Alex W.: CI perf job flagged +12% p95 for same test. Staging trace attached: `kv-get` tail latency spikes after first 200 tokens.
Priya S.: can we bisect to confirm?
Miguel R.: yes, bisect narrowed it to 9a1b2c3 -> kernel selector change. I have a minimal repro harness: `scripts/perf/repro_kv_tail.py --model llama-13b --seq 1024 --prefill 200`
Jenna L.: can we rollback quickly? Impacting production canaries (5% of traffic) — ops reported 3 customer-facing errors due to timeouts.
Alex W.: ops-bot paused the rollout automatically (canary SLO gate triggered). deploy-bot: "Canary paused: reason=latency_tailspike, metric=p95_token_latency, threshold=2.5s, observed=3.1s"
deploy-bot: "Canary details: env=prod-eu, rollout=5%, affected=kv-heavy routes"
Priya S.: plan: revert selector change and re-run canary, or tighten selector to avoid int8 for seq>512. Thoughts?
Miguel R.: tightener seems safer short-term. The selector logic assumes prefix lengths are small; we missed long prefill cases.
Jenna L.: agree. Revert may be disruptive if there were other unrelated fixes in the commit. Prefer a config toggle to opt-out quantized kernels for heavy-kv class.
Alex W.: propose adding a canary/pre-flight synthetic that mimics kv-heavy tail: run `perf-sim` for 2000 synthetic requests per canary node before letting traffic in. Also proposed automatic rollback rule: if p95 > threshold for 10m within first 30m, fully revert canary and pin previous revision.
Priya S.: draft gate config below (for Redwood canary-gates):
```json
{
  "gate_name": "kv_tail_guard",
  "scope": "canary",
  "preflight": {
    "synthetic_workload": "kv_prefill",
    "requests": 2000,
    "seq_distribution": [256,512,1024]
  },
  "slo": {
    "metric": "p95_token_latency",
    "threshold_seconds": 2.5,
    "evaluation_window_minutes": 10
  },
  "auto_actions": {
    "on_fail": ["pause_rollout","revert_to_previous","notify_ops"]
  }
}
```
Miguel R.: I can add a short-circuit in kernel selector: `if (prefill_len > 512 && workload_has_kv) prefer_fp16 = true` — avoids int8 path.
Jenna L.: can we get a hotfix today and a full revert if more regressions show up?
Alex W.: yes. Miguel, ship the short-circuit as a patch to main and open a rollback PR for 9a1b2c3. Priya, add the gate config to the canary pipeline. I'll coordinate the canary re-run.
Miguel R.: on it, pushing patch to branch `hotfix/kernel-prefill-guard` now.
Priya S.: adding gate to pipeline: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/kv-canary-gates (draft).
Alex W.: ops, please keep canary at 0% until we confirm preflight. @deploy-bot when preflight passes, only then allow traffic.
deploy-bot: "Acknowledged. Canary will remain paused until manual resume or preflight success."
Jenna L.: quick note for postmortem: we need a unit test for selector heuristics that simulates long prefix + kv access. Also add perf regression alert that fails PR checks if p95 increases >8% on canary-sim.
Miguel R.: agreed, adding tests and a CI perf baseline. Repro script and perf profile uploaded to the perf bucket: s3://redwood-perf/repro/1987654321_kv_tail/
Alex W.: thanks everyone. Will post updates when hotfix lands and canary preflight completes. :thumbsup:
